repaired.name: Scenario

diagnosis.summary: The IR checks if the volume dropped (v1 - v2 >= 20), but the JoI checks if it rose (v2 - v1 >= 20). Evidence F2 shows the JoI emitted 'Volume dropped' when volume stayed constant at 20, which should not trigger. Evidence F3 line 4 confirms the incorrect subtraction order.
diagnosis.change_summary: Reversed the subtraction order in the condition from (v2 - v1) to (v1 - v2) to match the IR's logic for detecting a volume drop.
